cands.bio: Democrat and Birmingham-area attorney and professor at Miles Law School. Won the Democratic primary runoff in June 2026 for Alabama House District 52 over LaTanya Millhouse, after the primary defeated incumbent Kelvin Datcher. She has not previously held elected office.

endorsements.text: Tabitha's List: Candidates You Can Trust (Sway voting group by Tabitha Isner), listed as a voter guide recommendation on Ballotpedia.

cands.gaps: We could not find where she was born or raised, or when she came to Alabama beyond her campaign's description of her as a lifelong Jefferson County resident. She has no prior record in office. We found no documented stances on data centers, development, homestead taxes, land ownership, immigration, policing, guns or abortion. Her only education statement is about school funding and teacher pay, with nothing on school choice. She did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey. The Wikipedia page has almost no detail. No controversies or foreign ties turned up in the pages we had.
